transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's nice to meet you too. Well, I’m here because for months now, I’ve been seeing the exact same pattern. My sister’s appointments keep getting moved, bills show up wrong, and people just seem to forget to call me back. 

Everyone keeps telling me it’s just mistakes, but... I know they’re keeping information from me. It's clear they're trying to push me out of making decisions.
Have you been needing much less sleep than usual without feeling tired?
No, not really. My sleep has been pretty normal. I mean, if I don't get a full night's rest, I definitely feel tired the next day at work. So I haven't experienced anything like needing less sleep.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?

No, I haven't. I don't hear voices or... anything like that. My hearing is fine. It's really just the actual, physical things happening around me that I'm dealing with, like the schedules and the paperwork I mentioned. But no, no voices.
Have there been times when your mood felt unusually high or euphoric?

No, I haven't. My mood is... well, it's pretty steady. I definitely haven't felt euphoric or unusually high. If anything, I'm just frustrated with how people are handling things behind my back with the schedules and everything. But no, nothing like what you're describing. I just feel like my normal self, just dealing with a very stressful situation.
For how long have you been convinced that people are deliberately keeping information from you?

Well, it's been going on for about 11 months now. It started right around the time my sister's health suddenly got worse. I had to step in and start coordinating all her care, and... that's when I really started noticing it happening.
Have people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that your thoughts seem jumbled?

No, no one has ever said anything like that to me. I speak pretty clearly, I think. My thoughts are perfectly organized—I have to be organized to manage my sister's care and my own work. So, no, my speech is completely normal.
Aside from this situation with your sister’s care, has your ability to work or manage your daily life gotten noticeably worse?

No, not at all. Outside of dealing with my sister’s appointments and... well, trying to get straight answers from everyone, everything else is fine. I still keep my home in order, I pay my bills, and I do my job just like I always have. 

I mean, people might think I’m a little too focused on this whole situation, but I’m definitely not falling apart or acting strangely in other parts of my life. I'm just managing what needs to be managed.
